for a death or a crime: has the police or the medical examiner released the place
is anyone who died still there
who has the right to the property: the owner, the estate or next of kin, or the landlord or manager
about how big the affected area is (rooms, floors)
is an insurance claim being filed
safety_stop: someone is hurt or not breathing
the person who died is still there
the place is still taped off by police
a strong chemical smell or a drug lab
